objectives.title: Establish the link
objectives.brief: Raise the probe and confirm it is listening.

hints.text: Section 3.1 of the manual lists the commands the probe accepts. Start with the one that costs nothing.

objectives.title: Read the downlink
objectives.brief: Confirm the probe is healthy and reporting science. All six instruments should be present in the frame.

hints.text: Each channel is a type-length-value triple after the fixed header. Manual section 5.3 gives the channel IDs.

objectives.title: Silence the magnetometer
objectives.brief: Power down the magnetometer and confirm from telemetry that its channel has left the downlink entirely.

partial.text: The magnetometer is quiet, but so is the inertial unit — and more besides. Whatever you wrote reached further than one instrument. Check the address against the slot size.
A write was accepted but the magnetometer is still reporting. Either the address was not its control register, or the bit you cleared was not the power bit.

hints.text: The sensor register block is eight identical slots. Manual section 6.1 gives the slot layout; the base address of the block is not in the recovered pages.
Each slot is 16 bytes: control, status, data, power draw. Bit 0 of control is power.
